title: Access and use HyFlex classrooms
issue: You need to access or request HyFlex classrooms
resolution_html:
1. Use the built-in classroom computer and sign in with Passport York
  2. Open Zoom and start the meeting
  3. Use the classroom touch panel to enable Broadcast for remote camera and microphone feeds
  4. Check that PC audio is selected and the room microphone is working

For a problem, contact askIT and include the service and any error shown
